tests.name: model schema validation
tests.pass: every model declares all carriers and interpretations

tests.name: semantic determinism
tests.pass: same model and expression produce same result

tests.name: typed partiality
tests.pass: undefined and ill-typed results are distinct

tests.name: alpha/substitution preservation
tests.pass: capture-avoiding substitution preserves interpretation where defined

tests.name: countermodel completeness
tests.pass: each rejected general rule has a recorded countermodel

tests.name: cross-model soundness
tests.pass: declared inference rules preserve truth in every tested model

tests.name: claim boundary
tests.pass: no completeness or consistency claim without its proof obligation

required_model_classes: one independently chosen typed model class
